product_metadata.title: Acrylic Stemless Wine Glasses and Water Tumblers, Home Unbreakable Made of Shatterproof Plastic for Indoor and Outdoor Use, Reusable (Blue)
features: BRIGHTEN UP THE PARTY: No longer serve your guests with unattractive plastic. Shatterproof tumblers are both elegant and long-lasting. The Unbreakable Colored Stemless Wine Glasses comes with a set of four multi-colored glasses, and each holds up to 35ML of your favorite wine water or juice.

UNBREAKABLE ACRYLIC TUMBLERS: Each glass is made with the incredibly sturdy and BPA-free plastic material. They are crystal clear and looks just like glass, yet won’t shatter even if dropped outdoors. KEEP THE BRILLIANT SHINE: We recommend to hand wash them gently without harsh abrasive detergents or scouring pads to keep them looking their best.

A PERFECT GIFT IDEA: We make a wide array of products for every home and garden lover. Whether you're looking for a perfect gift to spruce up your friend's garden, or if you need a housewarming present,this preduct has something for everyone!

MAKE A HOUSE A HOME: The glass set offers beautifully designed clocks, dishware, garden decorations, and more to add a special style to any home. Whether you’re looking for a statement piece for your living room or looking for a way to add more color to your garden, the glass has just what you’re looking for!
Package A Set of Acrylic Glass (6 PCS)
